column3: NKJV lacks “today,” as does the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “held Jesus,” following the Textus Receptus wording; the critical text reads “held Him.”
NKJV includes “they struck Him on the face,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “they were asking Him.”
Close to the Greek; “the elderhood” is rendered “the elders.”
NKJV includes “Me or let Me go,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “you will not answer.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “rightly.”
